# Romain Fernex {.unnumbered}

::: {.intro}
I am a predoctoral research assistant at **Bocconi University (IGIER)**, working with **Giulia Giupponi** and **Thomas Le Barbanchon**.
:::

My work and academic projects focus on labour economics, occupational choice, and inequality. I combine applied econometrics with structural modelling and computational methods.

[Download my CV](Resources/CV_Romain_Fernex.pdf){.btn-cta} [Master thesis](thesis.qmd){.btn-ghost} [Research experience](Research.qmd){.btn-ghost}
:::

## About {.unnumbered}

I completed the Master in Economics at Sciences Po in 2026, following a Master in Management at ESCP Business School and a dual-degree programme at Korea University. Before joining IGIER, I worked as a research assistant to Jean-Marc Robin at Sciences Po.

[Master's thesis · Sciences Po]{.eyebrow}

### [Self-employment and dual jobholding](thesis.qmd)

How the 2018 microentrepreneurship reform reshaped occupational choices in France, combining interrupted time series evidence with a structural occupational choice model.

[Read the overview →]{.card-more}
:::

::: {.work-card .mid}
[Replication study · Labour economics]{.eyebrow}

### [Workweek restrictions during the Great Depression](papers/labor-replication.qmd)

A replication and robustness analysis of Fishback et al.'s study of the 1933 President's Reemployment Agreement.

[Read the overview →]{.card-more}
:::

::: {.work-card .warm}
[Group paper · Game theory]{.eyebrow}

### [Superbonus: a game-theoretic analysis](Microeconomics_project.qmd)

A signalling model of hidden public debt and fiscal-rule enforcement, motivated by Italy's Superbonus policy.

[Read the overview →]{.card-more}
